newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SOCCER-SOUTH AFRICA MAKE CHANGES FOR CRUCIAL CUP CLASH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SOUTH AFRICA MAKE CHANGES FOR CRUCIAL CUP CLASH.

text.p: South Africa coach Clive Barker has called up uncapped defender Isaac Shai and omitted experienced fullback David Nyathi and striker Jerry Sikhosana from his squad for the vital World Cup qualifier against Congo on August 16.
The squad for the Johannesburg match includes 13 foreign-based players.
Both sides are level on 10 points at the head of Africa qualifying group three but a superior goal difference means that South Africa only need to draw to reach the finals for the first time.
Congo must win to go through.
Goalkeepers - Mark Anderson (Umtata Bucks), Andre Arendse (Fulham, England), Brian Baloyi (Kaizer Chiefs)

Defenders - Mark Fish (Lazio, Italy), Sizwe Motaung (Tenerife, Spain), Andrew Rabutla (PAOK Salonika, Greece), Lucas Radebe (Leeds United, England), Isaac Shai (Mamelodi Sundowns), Neil Tovey (Kaizer Chiefs)

Midfielders - Linda Buthelezi (Mamelodi Sundowns), Doctor Khumalo (Columbus Crew, U.S), Clinton Larsen (Manning Rangers), Thomas Madigage (Supersport United), Helman Mkhalele (Gaziantepspor, Turkey), John Moeti (Orlando Pirates), John Moshoeu (Kocaelispor, Turkey), Dumisa Ngobe (Orlando Pirates), Eric Tinkler (Barnsley, England)

Strikers - Brendan Augustine (LASK Linz, Austria), Shaun Bartlett (New Jersey-New York MetroStars, U.S.), Phil Masinga (Bari, Italy), Pollen Ndlanya (Bursaspor, Turkey), Mark Williams (Kaizer Chiefs).
